title: Nobunaga no Yabou Tenshouki (Demo)
overview:
Will the strongest Nobunaga army in history appear? The supreme authentic historical simulation.

As a Sengoku daimyo, you command your "corps" while enriching your domain and expanding your territory, aiming to unify the whole country from Ezo in the north to Satsuma in the south. Enjoy the heated developments to the fullest.

Powered up by making the most of the Saturn's unique features!
- Even more beautiful graphics: 32,000-color face CG, commands and historical events that unfold in movies, and even a Noh dance in the opening.
- Includes a general file that tells the profiles of the generals who appear.
- BGM quality only CD-ROM can deliver. Yoko Kanno's heroic melodies ring out.

- Strategy is handled by "corps". You can organize them with the daimyo at the top, which raises the strategic depth and enables speedy play. Generals also grow depending on their training, so you can build corps you can rely on.
- About 1,000 generals appear. Detailed ability values and "special skills" such as eloquence and assassination are also key to strategy.
- Heated battles where friend and foe clash. Both strategy and tactics are key, including pre-war diplomacy.
- 214 famous castles from across the land appear.
- Multi-scenario system with three scenarios, and multiplayer for up to 8 players.

史上最強の信長軍団、登場なるか。至高の本格派歴史シミュレーション。

戦国大名となったあなたは、配下の『軍団』を操りながら、国を富ませ自国を広げ、北は蝦夷地から南は薩摩までの全国統一をめざします。白熱する展開を存分にお楽しみください。

サターンならではの機能を活かしてパワーアップ！
●グラフィックも一段と美麗に／32,000色の顔CG、ムービーで展開するコマンドや歴史イベント、さらにオープニングでは能の舞も。
●登場武将のプロフィールを語る武将ファイルを搭載。
●BGMのクオリティもCD-ROMならでは。菅野よう子の勇壮なメロディが鳴り響く。

●戦略は「軍団」単位へ。大名を頂点に組織化できるので戦略性も高まりスピーディな展開が可能に。また教育次第で武将は成長するので、信頼に足る軍団がつくれる。
●登場武将は約1,000人。詳細な能力値や弁舌・暗殺などの「特技」も戦略の要に。
●敵味方相乱れる白熱の合戦。戦前の外交戦略も含め戦略・戦術両方が鍵になる。
●各地の名城214が登場。
●3本のシナリオによるマルチシナリオ方式・最大8人までのマルチプレイ方式を採用。
